transformer.name: Transformer
transformer.description: A new simple network architecture based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

attention_mechanism.name: Attention Mechanism
attention_mechanism.description: A mechanism that connects encoder and decoder and forms the basis of the Transformer architecture.

recurrent_neural_networks.name: Recurrent Neural Networks
recurrent_neural_networks.description: Neural networks established as state-of-the-art approaches in sequence modeling and transduction problems.

convolutional_neural_networks.name: Convolutional Neural Networks
convolutional_neural_networks.description: Complex neural network architectures previously used for sequence transduction models.

encoder_decoder_architecture.name: Encoder-Decoder Architecture
encoder_decoder_architecture.description: A neural network structure comprising an encoder and a decoder used in sequence transduction.

machine_translation.name: Machine Translation
machine_translation.description: Sequence transduction tasks such as WMT 2014 English-to-German and English-to-French translation.

scaled_dot_product_attention.name: Scaled Dot-Product Attention
scaled_dot_product_attention.description: Attention mechanism computed using dot products of queries and keys, scaled by the square root of key dimension.

multi_head_attention.name: Multi-Head Attention
multi_head_attention.description: Attention mechanism consisting of several attention layers running in parallel with different learned linear projections.

additive_attention.name: Additive Attention
additive_attention.description: Attention function that computes compatibility using a feed-forward network with a single hidden layer.

softmax_function.name: Softmax Function
softmax_function.description: Activation function applied to obtain weights on values in attention mechanisms.

dropout.name: Dropout
dropout.description: Regularization technique applied to sums of embeddings and positional encodings

label_smoothing.name: Label Smoothing
label_smoothing.description: Regularization technique that improves accuracy and BLEU score

bleu.name: BLEU
bleu.description: Metric for evaluating machine translation quality

beam_search.name: Beam Search
beam_search.description: Search algorithm used for decoding during inference
